messages:
alex: Handoff — I'm on for the night. Planned rolling deploy at 23:45 UTC for router-service v2.3.7. Expected work: one lightweight index migration on user_routes, and a cache flush that will warm KV prefix. Freeze window: 23:30–00:30 UTC. I'll be primary until 03:00 UTC. Asking for 1 rollout watcher (eng-sre) + 1 perf observer (eng-runtime).
priya: ack. I'll take the rollout watcher role and run the smoke checklist.
jamal: I ran the migration in staging earlier today, can trigger in prod if needed. Migration is quick but will cause short p99 blips on route-add calls (~20–45s).
priya: thanks — pls trigger and ping when started. I'll monitor errors + traces.
lia: FYI the kv-cache warmup runs as a post-deploy job (idempotent). Command is `cache-warm --prefix /kv/router` — it streams keys and will add a bit of write load for ~2m.
oncall-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: build 0.3.7 -> canary(2 nodes) -> health checks (30s interval) -> rollout policy = linear 33%/min. Logs will be posted here.
alex: Important: keep quantization toggle OFF for this deploy (we saw tokenization diffs previously). Release flag `feature.quantize` = false in rollout config.
jamal: confirmed — quantization disabled. Rollback plan: revert commit 12ab9f and scale down canary to 0 nodes, then re-run migration later.
priya: smoke checklist I'm running: login, simple generation, route-add, billing write. Will paste quick results within 15m. Abort criteria: any error >5% or p95 latency increase >200ms.
alex: agree. If aborting, notify #incidents and tag me and @jamal. Also watch downstream latencies for inference-proxy (trace link).
jamal: starting canary trigger in ~2m. Will post start time and health check summary.
lia: dashboards pinned: https://graf.redwood/ops/router-service and logs https://logs.redwood/streams/router — I'll monitor tail for 5m after canary.
priya: can confirm smoke step 1 (login) OK on canary node. No errors in logs yet.
oncall-bot: Canary health: 2/2 nodes healthy; success rate 100% over last 1m; avg latency 120ms.
jamal: migration run completed, took 18s on the short lock. No schema change, just index rebuild.
priya: running rest of smoke tests now. Gen test returned expected outputs. Routing latency p95 at 180ms (within threshold).
alex: Great. Proceed to linear rollout when you have 5m stable. Keep an eye on KV warmup job — if it spikes IOPS >75%, pause.
lia: noted — I set an alert threshold on IOPS at 70% for 10m.
priya: proceeding with linear rollout now. Will post minute-by-minute checks. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all — leaving handoff notes in runbook (see pinned message). If anything odd, escalate. Good luck and ping if you want me awake.
jamal: thanks, leaving this thread open for post-rollout notes.
